supporting_pages.title: "About transparent data encryption (TDE) \_|\_ Cloud SQL for SQL Server \_\
evidence_snippets: Limitations Available only in Cloud SQL for SQL Server instances with the following database versions : SQL Server Enterprise SQL Server 2019 or later (Standard edition) If TDE is used for an instance with replicas and VPC Service Controls are enabled, then you must ensure the primary instance and all replicas are within the same service perimeter.

TDE is used in scenarios where another layer of encryption is required in addition to Google's default offering of encryption for data at rest and Google's optional offering of Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) .
A certificate, which is generated from the database primary key, is used to protect the data encryption keys.
